key_impacts: Fishermen lost most of their fishing boats.
Parts of mangrove forests remained submerged.
Few lives lost due to timely coast guard warnings.
evidence_snippets: Within two hours, mountains of waves started to hit the coast; fishermen lost most boats; properties in low-lying areas were destroyed.
Parts of our mangroves are still under water; very few lives were lost due to coast guard warnings.
